name: South Fork Payette
gaugeName: South Fork Payette River at Lowman
blurb: Canyon water out of Lowman — hot springs on the bank, Swirly Canyon in the middle, Garden Valley at the bottom.

sections.notes: The Kirkham/Lowman to Deadwood area includes Class III+ rapids in BLM guide SF02. Staircase is much farther downstream, between Garden Valley and Banks; it is not above Lowman.
sections.accessReview: Kirkham and Lowman are different launch locations. The former six-mile listing combined them; a specific legal landing and matching distance must be established before enabling this trip.

sections.notes: BLM guide SF04 covers 8.6 miles from Danskin to Alder Creek; SF05 adds 4.4 miles from Alder Creek to Confluence. Stop at the Garden Valley/Middle Fork confluence access. Continuing to Banks enters the more difficult Staircase run.

distanceEvidence.sourceName: BLM Payette River guide, SF04 + SF05
distanceEvidence.streamId: South Fork Payette / Danskin to Confluence
distanceEvidence.note: Sum of contiguous BLM guide lengths: SF04 8.6 miles plus SF05 4.4 miles. This is a guide length, not a GPS trace.

sections.routeReview: Approximate river-course overview with generalized bends and gravel bars. The dotted line does not identify safe rapid lines, current obstructions, exact landings or bank access.

notices.title: Check seasonal access and parking fees
notices.text: Banks and Danskin list a late-May through late-September season, subject to snow. Confirm current access before setting a shuttle. BLM lists $5/day parking or the $30 Boise National Forest Annual Day Use Pass at Beehive Bend and Confluence. Follow the signs at the facility.
notices.sourceName: BLM / Boise National Forest — Payette boating facilities

notices.title: Finish at Confluence near Garden Valley
notices.text: The takeout is just below the Middle Fork junction. Continuing downstream toward Banks enters Class IV Staircase whitewater. The dotted overview ends at this trip’s takeout vicinity; it is not a rapid-running guide.

putInAccess.sourceName: Boise National Forest facility page and Payette River boating guide
putInAccess.note: USFS site 5531.002731 and BLM guide SF04 identify the South Fork Payette launch. The marker is an approximate facility area inland of the river, not an exact landing. Day use only; USFS lists late May through late September, subject to snow. The separate South Fork Boise site is not part of this trip.
putInAccess.directions: Use Danskin Rest Area Boating Site beside the South Fork Payette on Banks-Lowman Road. This is not Danskin Floatboat Access on the South Fork Boise River. Use the signed public facility and check seasonal access before setting a shuttle.

takeOutAccess.sourceName: Bureau of Land Management facility page and Payette River boating guide
takeOutAccess.note: BLM documents a gravel ramp and parking at this takeout. The marker uses its approximate facility-area coordinate; no exact landing or shore connector is claimed. Day use only. The current BLM page lists $5 daily parking or the $30 Boise National Forest Annual Day Use Pass; check posted fees and conditions.
takeOutAccess.directions: Use the BLM Confluence boating site on Banks-Lowman Road just downstream of the Middle Fork/South Fork Payette junction. This is the Garden Valley takeout, not the North Fork confluence at Banks. Finish here; continuing downstream enters the harder Staircase run.
